title: Akule: Fast and Scalable Multi-Robot Motion Planning via Sparse Interaction Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.14248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models provide expressive trajectory priors for multi-robot motion planning (MRMP), but scaling them to large teams requires coordinating individual motions without expensive joint computation. We introduce Akule, a sparse interaction diffusion framework that augments a frozen single-robot prior with three learned modules: a reusable pairwise correction model $R_{\phi}$, a contextual selector $U_{\psi}$ that determines which corrections to evaluate, and a composer $G_{\omega}$ that combines their effects through context-dependent signed weights. This decomposition separates which interactions merit computation from how their effects should be combined into coordinated denoising updates. We train $R_{\phi}$ using matched pairwise trajectory optimizations, then learn $G_{\omega}$ and $U_{\psi}$ from physically optimized joint trajectories without requiring a prescribed ground-truth interaction graph. translated_title: Akule：基于稀疏交互扩散的快速可扩展多机器人运动规划
translated_abstract: 扩散模型为多机器人运动规划（MRMP）提供了富有表现力的轨迹先验，但将其扩展到大规模机器人团队时，需要在不进行昂贵的联合计算的前提下协调各个机器人的运动。我们提出了Akule，这是一个稀疏交互扩散框架，它在冻结的单机器人先验基础上增加了三个学习模块：一个可复用的成对修正模型 $R_{\phi}$、一个决定评估哪些修正的上下文选择器 $U_{\psi}$，以及一个通过依赖上下文的带符号权重来组合各修正效果的组合器 $G_{\omega}$。这种分解将“哪些交互值得计算”与“如何将交互效果组合为协调的去噪更新”分离开来。我们使用匹配的成对轨迹优化来训练 $R_{\phi}$，然后从经过物理优化的联合轨迹中学习 $G_{\omega}$ 和 $U_{\psi}$，无需预先指定的真实交互图。由此得到的联合提案……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Akule通过在冻结的单机器人先验上叠加可复用的成对修正模型、上下文选择器和带符号权重组合器三个学习模块，实现了无需昂贵联合计算的快速可扩展多机器人运动规划。
